thread:
ria: Quick handoff — I'm taking off for the evening. Leaving a few watch items on GPU pools.
Tom: Thanks — have a good one. what's the current alpha pool headroom?
ria: Alpha is ~18% free (2 of 11 nodes idle), beta sitting at ~6%. Seen a small burst from customer 'atlas' earlier that used ~70% of their quota window.
jamal: FYI I bumped atlas burst cap to 120% for the next hour per their request. Monitor for regressions.
kevin: Noted. Any queued long-running eval jobs that might eat headroom overnight?
ria: There are 3 scheduled eval jobs starting at 01:15 UTC: eval-embed-100k, rl-eval-2, nightly-smoke. Only eval-embed-100k has higher memory; it's pinned to pool 'gamma' though.
oncall-bot: Scheduled job alert: eval-embed-100k will start in 1h (01:15 UTC). See /schedules#evals
Tom: Good — gamma's separate. Should we soft-swap one node from alpha -> burst-pool to keep latency headroom for hosted API?
jamal: I can do a soft swap in 10m if no objections. It won't affect reserved Dedicated customers.
kevin: +1 do it. Leave a revert timer 30m if utilization doesn't drop.
ria: Command to check pool metrics quick:
```
redwoodctl pool metrics --pool alpha --fields utilization,free_nodes,queued
```
jamal: Running swap now:
```
redwoodctl pool swap --from alpha --to burst-pool --nodes 1 --soft --revert 1800
```
Tom: Thx. I'll keep an eye on traces and latency dashboards (Console -> Models -> alpha -> Live)
ria: Also flagging burst limits: if we see sustained >85% across alpha for >10m, escalate to SRE and consider auto-scale. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pool-burst
kevin: Logged. If you get any rate-limit errors from atlas, mention me and I'll coordinate quota bump with CS.
jamal: Swap completed. alpha free_nodes now 3. Utilization down to ~70% from 78%.
ria: Perfect. I'm off now — ping me if something noisy pops. :wave:
Tom: Thanks ria. Good handoff.
kevin: Copy — monitoring, standing by.
oncall-bot: Handoff note recorded by ria at 2029-07-14T00:02:03Z"
